title: Chapter 7 distribution — Garrison Tools
instructions: **Garrison Tools, Inc.** filed a voluntary Chapter 7 petition. The trustee has sold all assets. Compute each creditor group's recovery, then answer the questions that follow.

exhibits.title: Estate and claims
exhibits.content:
- Cash from sale of equipment that secured First Bank's loan: **$110,000**
- Cash from all other assets: **$300,000**

| Claim | Amount |
|---|---:|
| First Bank (secured by the equipment) | 150,000 |
| Trustee's fees and administrative expenses | 20,000 |
| Employee wages earned within 180 days before filing (within the statutory cap) | 15,000 |
| Federal income taxes (priority) | 25,000 |
| General unsecured trade creditors | 440,000 |

exhibits.title: Other facts
exhibits.content:
- 45 days before filing, while insolvent, Garrison paid a trade creditor, Kline Co., $12,000 on an overdue invoice (not in the ordinary course).
- Garrison's CEO personally guaranteed First Bank's loan.

rows.label: First Bank's recovery from its collateral
rows.explanation: The secured creditor receives the proceeds of its collateral: **110,000**.

rows.label: Total paid to priority claims (administrative, wages, taxes)
Percentage paid on general unsecured claims
The $12,000 payment to Kline Co.
options: Recoverable by the trustee as a preferential transfer
Protected because Kline isn't an insider
Protected because it was less than $25,000
rows.answer: Recoverable by the trustee as a preferential transfer
rows.explanation: Antecedent debt, while insolvent, within 90 days, not ordinary course.

rows.label: First Bank's right against the CEO for the unpaid $20,000
options: First Bank may collect from the CEO as surety
Only if the CEO was an officer when the loan was made
rows.answer: First Bank may collect from the CEO as surety
rows.explanation: The debtor's bankruptcy isn't a defense for the surety.

rows.label: Effect of the petition on a pending supplier lawsuit against Garrison
rows.explanation: The automatic stay halts collection actions.
